known_divergences.detail: Source site references https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/lenis/1.0.42/lenis.min.js, which returns HTTP 404 -- 'lenis' is not published on cdnjs (1.0.x shipped as @studio-freight/lenis). On the live site Lenis is therefore undefined and the about-page smooth-scroll handler throws. The mirror reproduces this by intentionally leaving this path absent so it 404s identically. A working copy is vendored unwired at assets/js/vendor/_optional/lenis.min.js.

Removed at the user's request; the family 'OTF Obys NG' now resolves to the locally installed Helvetica Neue LT Std via src: local(). No font file is stored in this project or served over HTTP. Measured divergence: advance widths within 1-2% (all-caps strings without spaces within 0.31%), cap height 70.0 vs 71.4 and x-height 50.6 vs 51.7 per 100px em. Nearly all residual error is a wider word space. No tracking correction applied - see docs/fidelity-report.md section 3.2.
